description: The sealed oracle pack for a slug as deterministic JSON: markdown, verified claims with byte-exact quotes and spans, source CIDs, licence (CMI), receipt hashes, review, labels, strength. Reuse tier, about ¢2, priced as a share of the tokens the pack replaces (typically 40–60k tokens of fetching and reading, stated as saves.tokens next to the price). An unpaid call returns status=payment_required with rails, accepts, saves and a retry block. Stubs are free.

pow_challenge.description: The challenge from a payment_required result

pow_nonce.description: Nonce such that SHA-256(challenge || ':' || nonce) has difficulty_bits leading zero bits

slug.description: Wiki slug from match, thin, or density

work_token.description: Work-rail token (deai_wk_…) earned with the work tool; spends credit on this node. Same as sending Authorization: Bearer.

x_payment.description: x402 v1 PaymentPayload, base64 JSON, for one of `accepts` (when the USDC rail is open)

name: read_page
title: Read a sealed oracle pack (reuse tier, about ¢2)
